headline: Southwest Airlines launched a ChatGPT plugin that lets people search and compare its flights and fares inside ChatGPT, though booking still happens on Southwest.com.
score_reason: Verified launch with clear limits (no points bookings, no in-chat payment); modest effect; score kept.
importance_line: Travellers can compare Southwest cash fares inside ChatGPT, but must finish booking on the airline's site and cannot use Rapid Rewards points there.
summary: Upgraded Points reports that Southwest launched a ChatGPT plugin on 6 Oct 2026 that lets travellers search Southwest flights and compare its four fare types inside the chat, and says it is the first US airline to do so after Virgin Atlantic in April. Booking and payment still happen on Southwest.com, the plugin shows only cash fares, and Southwest describes it as the first step in a multiphase AI plan without saying what comes next.
notes: Reporter tested searches; fares matched Southwest.com. "First US airline" is the outlet's claim.
